description_en: Modifies the remark of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-instance-remark --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --remark new-remark --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceRemark

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to manage.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the remark of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.

The remark can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and some special characters such as `,.+-*/_`. The remark can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
为DDoS高防实例设置备注。

支持使用中文字符、英文大小写字符、数字及部分特殊字符，例如：`,.+-*/_`。最长不允许超过500个字符
parameters.name: remark

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
